items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, but I didn’t know those people until I came back from New York.

ctx.x: area who are also looked at as pioneers in new music as well. You already mentioned Ornette, but there were others who were associated or – Eric Dolphy, Prince Lasha, Sonny Simmons, and we just lost Bishop Norman Williams yesterday.
Yeah, but I didn’t know those people until I came back from New York.
How about Bobby Bradford, who worked with Ornette, or John Carter? Did you know them?
